metadata.purpose: Rotate count-limited live multicast windows with overlapping, contiguous and gapped source-index policies.

conditions: Exactly one initial window handle plus one handle after every startEvery source values; handles can be empty.
Every source value is sent to all currently open windows; the oldest closes when its configured count is reached.
For startEvery < windowSize windows overlap; for equality they are adjacent; for startEvery > windowSize gaps occur.
Source completion closes remaining windows before outer complete; source error errors them before outer error.

scope.parameters: Positive safe integer windowSize, positive safe integer effective stride (zero argument normalized to windowSize); no count overflow.
scope.callbacks: No callback. Source values are opaque, retain identity, and are never buffered by this operator.
scope.time: Only source event order controls windows; no scheduler is introduced. Explicit event sequence resolves equal-time input order.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic post-setup source notifications, with child attachment between reactions. Synchronous producer/reentrant observer mutation excluded.
exclusions: Fractional, negative, non-finite or overflowing window size/stride/count; zero windowSize.
Synchronous source notifications during initial subscription setup and reentrant window-consumer callbacks.
Imperative access to Subject implementation, throwing observer teardowns and unmodeled foreign ObservableInput conversions.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Announce initial window zero synchronously, then acquire the source. Construction does not subscribe.

ownership.sharing: Result subscriptions are cold and independent. Each inner window is live multicast, no replay; window consumers do not keep the source connected.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Addressed child notifications precede outer notices. Count closure and new-handle emission are ordered. Tokens stand for Observable handles, not materialized buffers.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Independent observer attaches to an open or previously terminated window token.
Named window consumer closes its own connection.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Active.
Outer execution ended; completed/failed windows and orphaned consumers remain observable.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

actions: emit initial Observable handle 0
subscribe to source
rules.nextState: Window zero is open and empty before the source is connected.
rules.explanation: Construction is inert. Initial handle is emitted before the source subscription, enabling immediate child attachment.

rules.guard: safe source count and window identity
actions: send source value to each open window observer
complete oldest due window
open next window after delivery at stride boundary
rules.nextState: Count advances; windows are completed or opened without replaying values.
rules.explanation: RxJS 7.8.2 closes when (old count - windowSize + 1) is a nonnegative stride multiple. A new handle opens AFTER the value at each stride boundary, possibly empty at completion.

actions: complete each open child before outer completion
complete outer result
release source
rules.nextState: All remaining open handles remember completion; completed historical handles are unchanged.
rules.explanation: Completion does not emit another window. It completes even the empty window opened on the last source next.

actions: error each open child with same error identity
error outer result
release source
rules.nextState: Open handles retain the terminal error for late observers; earlier completed windows remain completed.
rules.explanation: No replacement error or buffer flush; notification order is each child then the outer subscriber.

actions: release source subscription silently
rules.nextState: Current open Subjects and their consumer subscriptions remain orphaned, unlike window(boundaries).
rules.explanation: windowCount finalization clears its internal array but does not complete, error, or unsubscribe its Subject windows. Late window observers can still attach to these silent Subjects.

rules.guard: fresh observer ID names an open window; after stop, only cancelled windows stay open
actions: acquire one named window observer subscription, no replay
rules.nextState: Observer joins the specified live Subject; no additional source subscription is made.
rules.explanation: Each window is a multicast Subject exposed as an Observable; consumers hold no upstream lease.

rules.guard: fresh observer ID names a completed window
actions: subscribe and synchronously complete the new window observer
release observer subscription
rules.nextState: No consumer remains attached; this completed Subject does not replay any values.
rules.explanation: Historical completed windows retain the completion notification even after the outer source has stopped.

rules.guard: addressed observer owns an open window subscription
actions: release only the addressed child subscription
rules.nextState: Window and all other consumers are unchanged; source lifetime remains independently owned.
rules.explanation: After outer cancellation, orphaned window observers can still unsubscribe independently.

rules.guard: fresh observer ID names an open window; after stop, only cancelled windows stay open
actions: acquire one named window observer subscription, no replay
rules.nextState: Observer joins the specified live Subject; no additional source subscription is made.
rules.explanation: Each window is a multicast Subject exposed as an Observable; consumers hold no upstream lease.

rules.guard: fresh observer ID names a completed window
actions: subscribe and synchronously complete the new window observer
release observer subscription
rules.nextState: No consumer remains attached; this completed Subject does not replay any values.
rules.explanation: Historical completed windows retain the completion notification even after the outer source has stopped.

rules.guard: fresh observer names a failed window, which can occur only after source error
actions: subscribe and immediately replay terminal error only
release observer subscription
rules.nextState: Observer is terminated with the same error identity; no value replay.
rules.explanation: A Subject retains its terminal failure for late observers, distinct from cancellation.

rules.guard: addressed observer owns an open window subscription
actions: release only the addressed child subscription
rules.nextState: Window and all other consumers are unchanged; source lifetime remains independently owned.
rules.explanation: After outer cancellation, orphaned window observers can still unsubscribe independently.
